screen.longboatlab.water.title: Water Nodes
screen.longboatlab.water.controls: MMB Pan    Wheel Zoom    Drag Move    Home Frame All    N Sidebar    Esc Close
screen.longboatlab.water.read_only: Read-only pipeline and live counters, not a shader editor. Arrow keys select nodes; Home fits the graph. Scroll the details panel.
screen.longboatlab.water.water.title: Water Input
screen.longboatlab.water.water.descripti: Water level, flow and shoreline mask. Tint and lighting from the current world.
screen.longboatlab.water.contact.title: Hull Input
screen.longboatlab.water.contact.descrip: Range 80 m. Limit 24 hulls, 2304 queries per tick. Outputs motion and entry events.
screen.longboatlab.water.pressure.title: Hull Pressure
screen.longboatlab.water.pressure.descri: Swept keel depression and wake shoulders. Pressure adds at the same water level. Limit 8 hulls.
screen.longboatlab.water.impact.title: Entry Impulse
screen.longboatlab.water.impact.descript: Entry direction, speed and area determine depression and outward pressure. Retained in world space, then decayed.
screen.longboatlab.water.field.title: Wave Simulation
screen.longboatlab.water.field.descripti: Size 48 × 48 m. Spacing 0.5 m. Substeps 3. Damping 0.13. Shared wave field; shore absorption and depth limits.
screen.longboatlab.water.material.title: Water Material
screen.longboatlab.water.material.descri: Height displacement and surface normals. Vanilla atlas, tint and light. Vanilla surface with Sodium / Iris.
screen.longboatlab.water.ribbon.title: Wake Geometry
screen.longboatlab.water.ribbon.descript: Bow pressure decays along the hull. Turning waves follow each segment’s outward motion. Shared endpoints join hull and wake. Geometry is separate from the height field.
screen.longboatlab.water.foam.title: Foam
screen.longboatlab.water.foam.descriptio: Breaking intensity follows wave steepness. Separate foam islands spill along the crest and outer slope, with clear water between them. Limit 48 landing ripples.
screen.longboatlab.water.splash.title: Splash Geometry
screen.longboatlab.water.splash.descript: Irregular folded crown. Rim breakup and spreading base. Gravity 0.042 m/tick². Membrane dissipates within about 0.5 s. Limit 16 groups.
screen.longboatlab.water.spray.title: Droplets and Mist
screen.longboatlab.water.spray.descripti: Droplet gravity 0.045 m/tick². Vapor diffuses at low speed and settles slowly. Limit 384 drops, 192 vapor patches.
screen.longboatlab.water.output.title: Render Output
screen.longboatlab.water.output.descript: Surface writes depth. Transparent effects render after water composition, color writes only. Hull waves, foam, gas and mist retain low-alpha edges.
screen.longboatlab.water.jets.title: Gas
screen.longboatlab.water.jets.descriptio: Emission from puffer mouths. Deceleration, diffusion and dissipation. Operator settings: /longboatlab jets density or force.
screen.longboatlab.water.controls_short: MMB Pan · Wheel Zoom · Home All · N Sidebar
